Within this clause, COR means Contracting Officer's Representative. If there is no COR appointed and identified to the Contractor, the term instead will mean the Program Manager or any other authorized individual responsible for technical oversight under the contract. “Work site” means the Government facility, office, construction site, and any other area within the Government office or facility that the Contractor must access to accomplish work under this contract. (2) The work performed under this contract shall only be accomplished by individuals (in the employment of the Contractor or any subcontractors) whose conduct and behavior is consistent with the efficiency of the Federal Service and the requirements of this contract, and who are acceptable to the contracting officer. performed under this contract. award_criteria.text: ........................................................................................................................... 6 13.0 Contractor’s Key Personnel ............................................................................................................................... 6 14.0 Site Visit .......................................................................................................................................................... 6 3 Project DARK CANYON CULVERT REPAIR General Information 1.0 Scope of Work Project consists of furnishing all labor, equipment, tools, transportation, incidentals, inspection, quality control and supplies necessary to complete the Dark Canyon culvert and road repair. Culvert repair materials have been supplied to the Government by Contech Engineered Solutions and shall be provided to the Contractor (see list of Government-provided materials in the attached Drawings and Exhibits). All other necessary materials (aggregate base, structural backfill, concrete, etc.) shall be provided by the Contractor. The Dark Canyon Culvert was damaged in May 2025, most likely due to the insufficient compaction of structural backfill during initial installation. The Contractor shall repair the existing 26'-0" span, 16'-7" rise single radius arch multi-plate culvert per the guidance of the manufacturer of both the original structure and the Government-provided culvert repair materials, Contech Engineered Solutions. INTRODUCTION: The United States Department of State’s Bureau for International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs (INL) collaborates with allied nations to enhance their security forces' ability to combat drug trafficking and other illicit activities. This collaboration focuses on supporting the Ecuadorian Navy (ECUNAV), which plays a crucial role in defending the nation's sovereignty and maintaining security across its maritime spaces. After repairs are made to the systems, interval testing and inspections (annual or 5-year) will be performed to achieve a passing report for the fire suppression systems. All required inspections, testing, and maintenance to be performed as per the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 25, Standard for Inspections, Testing, and Maintenance of Water-Based Fire Protection Systems and all other associated NFPA Standards. rmed as per the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 25, Standard for Inspections, Testing, and Maintenance of Water-Based Fire Protection Systems and all other associated NFPA Standards. This is considered a remote location, and connectivity can be an issue. Background YOSE has over 138 fire suppression systems in buildings parkwide. Each system is inspected each year and deficiencies identified. This project is to bring the fire suppression systems in the El Portal Residences known as the Motor Inn Cabins, Yosemite Valley residences, Wawona District residences, and Mather District residences into compliance with NFPA requirements. This project encompasses a total of 40 locations and represents 43 individual fire suppression systems. The contractor will perform tasks to rectify the fire suppression system deficiencies identified during the annual inspections. Installation shall occur on the existing 20’ x 12’ fenced- in concrete pad located outside the MOD2 Building A loading dock. 2. Vaporizer Lease & Installation: One (1) 5,000 cubic foot per hour liquid nitrogen vaporizer and appropriate pressure regulator assembly shall be delivered and installed (to include all freight, rigging, and crane services) on an annual lease basis on the existing concrete pad outside MOD 2 Building A. urrent facility configuration, a separate reserve tank is not required. 75F40126Q133840-A00001 4 of 18 9. Demarcation & Final Assembly: The FDA/CVM will provide only the stainless steel piping extending from the building. The Contractor shall be responsible for the final assembly, including the pressure regulator(s) and any other component required to connect the building infrastructure to the tank. 10. Regulatory Compliance: The Contractor shall comply with all applicable Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), Department of Transportation (DOT), and hazardous materials handling regulations. Other Considerations/Requirements 1. Transition Plan: CVM/OAS currently utilizes an on -site 1,500-gallon tank that is leased and refueled under a legacy contract. The Contractor shall execute a seamless transition from the incumbent provider to the new equipment installation without disrupting facility operations. The Contractor shall detail its transition methodology within its written quote. This description shall include, but is not limited to, the logistics of swapping the tanks and the temporary solutions utilized to provide uninterrupted nitrogen gas to the facility during the swap. The quote shall incorporate all transition-related costs and logistics (includi

contractor) to remove the existing tank and install the new unit. If transition costs are not amortized into the standard lease rates, a separate one -time transition Contract Line Item Number (CLIN) may be utilized for rigging and installation fees; however, all total costs will be evaluated for award selection. 2. Procurements—Notice and Represen tation (OCT 2025) (a) Definitions. As used in this provision— Foreign person means any person other than a United States person. Specified Federal procurement payment means any payment made pursuant to a contract with a foreign contracting party that is for goods, manufactured or produced, or services provided in a foreign country that is not a party to an international procurement agreement with the United States. For purposes of the prior sentence, a foreign country does not include an outlying area of the United States. United States person as defined in 26 U.S.C. 7701(a)(30) means (1) A citizen or resident of the United States; (2) A domestic partnership; (3) A domestic corporation; (4) Any estate (other than a foreign estate, within the meaning of 26 U.S.C. 701(a)(31)); and (5) Any trust if– (i) A court within the United States is able to exercise primary supervision over the administration of the trust; and (ii) One or more United States persons have the authority to control all substantial decisions of the trust. (b) Unless exempted, there is a 2 percent tax of the amount of a specified Federal procurement payment on any foreign person receiving such payment. See 26 U.S.C. 5000C and its implementing regulations at 26 CFR 1.5000C- 1

The contractor will set forth the staffing and procedure for self -inspecting the quality, timeliness, responsiveness, customer satisfaction and other performance requirements in the SOW (Statement of Work) . Culvert repair materials have been supplied to the Government by Contech Engineered Solutions and shall be provided to the Contractor (see list of Government-provided materials in the attached Drawings and Exhibits). All other necessary materials (aggregate base, structural backfill, concrete, etc.) shall be provided by the Contractor. The Dark Canyon Culvert was damaged in May 2025, most likely due to the insufficient compaction of structural backfill during initial installation. The Contractor shall repair the existing 26'-0" span, 16'-7" rise single radius arch multi-plate culvert per the guidance of the manufacturer of both the original structure and the Government-provided culvert repair materials, Contech Engineered Solutions. This includes two (2) concrete collars at the joints of the original and repair materials. After the culvert has been repaired and road subgrade has been reconstructed to match the legacy design grades and elevations in the attached Drawings and Exhibits, an aggregate base surface course will be placed and compacted. Seedlings should be grown in nurseries within 400 miles of the refuge. 5. Unless other arrangements are made, seedlings shall be delivered during the first week of February 2027 through March 2027. This is considered a remote location, and connectivity can be an issue. Background YOSE has over 138 fire suppression systems in buildings parkwide. Each system is inspected each year and deficiencies identified. This project is to bring the fire suppression systems in the El Portal Residences known as the Motor Inn Cabins, Yosemite Valley residences, Wawona District residences, and Mather District residences into compliance with NFPA requirements. This project encompasses a total of 40 locations and represents 43 individual fire suppression systems. The contractor will perform tasks to rectify the fire suppression system deficiencies identified during the annual inspections. Deficiencies include the following, but not limited to interval testing, replace missing signage, replacing air and water gauges, installing electric bells, replacing recalled sprinkler heads, adding wrenches and heads for head boxes, replacing painted sprinkler heads, adjustment of water flow switches, and performing system inspections with passing reports. final_bank_contract: Decided GREEN/YELLOW/RED/FINAL_SUPER_GREEN results belong in control/final_supergreen_bank.json, never mixed into this inbox.
pipeline_contract: harvest -> rich-context Qwen triage -> DCE/evidence with document provenance -> deterministic post-DCE scope gate -> fair-share GPT Web inbox -> GPT Web review + tick -> final bank.
